text: थपथपाने पर गूंजती हुई आवाज़ से मिठास का पता चलता है -> थपथपाने से तरबूज की परिपक्वता (maturity) और घनत्व का पता चलता है, मिठास का नहीं। कोई भी वैज्ञानिक तरीका नहीं है जो बिना फल काटे उसकी मिठास की गारंटी दे सके।

भूरे लाइनों (webbing) का मिठास से कोई सीधा वैज्ञानिक संबंध नहीं है -> कृषि विज्ञान में इसे 'pollination webbing' कहा जाता है। यह मधुमक्खियों द्वारा परागण की अधिकता को दर्शाता है, जो अक्सर अधिक मीठे तरबूजों से जुड़ी होती है। 'कोई संबंध नहीं है' कहना गलत है।

फ्लैंज (flanges) भी होते हैं जो उसे पटरी से उतरने से रोकने में सबसे बड़ी भूमिका निभाते हैं -> This is a common myth. Flanges are a safety backup. The primary mechanism keeping a train on the tracks is the conical shape of the wheels (conicity/self-centering), not the flanges rubbing against the rail.

मोड़ पर, बाहरी पहिया बड़े हिस्से पर चढ़ जाता है -> Technically, the wheel doesn't 'climb' the rail; the wheelset shifts laterally due to centrifugal force, causing the outer wheel to roll on a larger diameter part of the cone, while the inner wheel rolls on a smaller diameter part.

अगर ये पत्थर हटा दिए जाएं तो ट्रैक धंस जाएगा और ट्रेन पटरी से उतर जाएगी -> This is an alarmist exaggeration. While ballast is critical for drainage and load distribution, many high-speed tracks (like slab tracks) have no ballast at all. The train would not instantly derail if ballast were removed fr

अगर Salmon को गहरे समंदर में ले जाएं तो क्या वो पैरासाइट-फ्री हो जाएगी? -> This is a misleading hypothetical. Salmon are biologically adapted to specific life cycles (anadromous); they cannot simply be 'moved' to the deep sea to live there, making the premise biologically flawed.

उस आवाज़ का असली कारण Cavitation है, यानी जोड़ों के अंदर अचानक बने गैस के बुलबुलों का फटना। -> The scientific consensus is that the sound is caused by the *formation* (collapse/rapid growth) of the bubble due to pressure drop, not the 'bursting' of an existing bubble. If this water were somehow released, it would significantly raise sea levels! -> The answer comment fails to answer the question posed in the video and title about how high sea levels would rise, using vague language instead of available scientific estimates (such as equivalent to several oceans).

said "Ever thought how that tiny hole balances cabin pressure so the outer glass doesn't shatter?" but The hole does not balance pressure between the cabin and the outside; it allows the middle pane to vent, ensuring the outer pane bears the pressure load and preventing fogging/condensation.

Maine tumhare kitchen ka stainless steel spoon microwave mein daala aur dekha kuch nahi hua. -> This is anecdotal and encourages dangerous behavior. While a spoon might not spark, metal can still reflect waves back into the magnetron and overheat, causing long-term damage.

Spoon ki shape hi hero hai, kyunki iska surface smooth aur rounded hai. -> The shape helps, but the primary reason the spoon is 'safe' is its thickness and lack of sharp points. Suggesting the shape makes it safe encourages users to test other 'smooth' metal objects which may still cause damage.

Ever thought why radiation utni asar nahi karti jab cockroach grow hi nahi kar raha? -> This phrasing is misleading. Cockroaches do grow (they molt and undergo metamorphosis). They are not static, but their cells divide significantly more slowly than human cells during their intermolt periods.

Jab barish sukhi mitti par girti hai, tabhi wo specific 'petrichor' wali khushboo aati hai. -> Petrichor is not exclusively caused by rain; it is caused by water hitting dry porous surfaces. As the video later admits, tap water also triggers it.

Question: Ever thought why tap water, jismein mitti ke compounds nahi hote, usmein wo sondhi khushboo kabhi nahi aati? -> The question contains a false premise: tap water does produce the smell when applied to dry soil containing the necessary compounds.

Cockroach cells divide slowly. -> Cockroach cells only divide slowly when the insect is in the adult stage. Nymphs (juveniles) have rapidly dividing cells, which is why they are much more susceptible to radiation damage than adults.

This neural signal is associated with an increased risk of developing Alzheimer’s up to eight years later -> While studies exist on predictive biomarkers, specifying exactly 'eight years' overstates the certainty of current clinical predictive power for individual patients.

By analyzing these patterns during the game, doctors can flag risk earlier than MRI or PET scans. -> Current clinical practice does not use this method; it is a research-stage approach. Using 'can' implies it is a currently available medical capability.
